text:
maria_sales: Quick Q from NorthCo bank. They want a CA-only POC: inference and logs must stay in Canada for the duration. BYOK required (customer HSM). They also want explicit deny for all EU regions and a clear sub-processor list. Need cost delta vs standard hosted and timeline for peering + key onboarding.

josh_sre: Short answer: hosted public API cannot promise CA-only because control-plane signals (metrics/telemetry) may hit other regions. We can do data-plane tenant pinning in Dedicated or Private to keep request/response + logs in ca-central-1. We can also lock out EU regions with routing rules. Failover to us-east-1 is acceptable if they allow it; otherwise we can do single-region private install.

josh_sre: Example policy snippet we use:
```
tenant_pin: ca-central-1
allowed_regions: [ca-central-1, us-east-1]
deny_regions: [eu-west-1, eu-central-1, eu-north-1]
failover: [us-east-1]
```

nina_security: We have a regional subprocessor matrix. High-level: cloud infra (GCP in ca-central-1), observability vendor (can be configured to retain logs in-region for Private), and a set of CDNs (not used for control plane). Detailed mapping requires an NDA. BYOK with customer HSM is supported in Private (fastest) and in Dedicated with managed-HSM options. Key onboarding + KMS attestation ~2-3 weeks typically.

tom_legal: We can add an amendment for "no EU egress" but need to define exceptions: software updates, control-plane health pings, and security alerts. Recommend we ask their legal to confirm what "no egress" means (data plane only or everything). Also need customer contact for DPA/NDA.

netops: For peering we need their BGP/ASN and CIDR blocks, expected throughput, and the SANs for TLS certs. Peering lead time depends on their provider: 10 business days for cloud interconnect. Note: cross-region failover will incur egress charges and latency spikes; we should surface that in the quote.

josh_sre: Pricing ballpark for a POC: Private single-region deployment (BYOK + customer HSM) ~"$28k/mo" including baseline infra; Dedicated mid-tier w/ managed-HSM ~"$22k/mo" + HSM add-on ~"$3.5k/mo". One-time peering/setup ~"$1.5k". We'll refine with exact GPU profile.

nina_security: I'll prepare a redacted subprocessor list (region-filtered) we can share pre-NDA and the partial security questionnaire answers. Will flag any EU-facing services.

maria_sales: Thanks — I'll send NDA + their security contact. I'll PM the bank asking whether they accept us-east failover as a last resort. Please DM me the formal quote once ready.
